description:
1. SKILL DISCOVERY: Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the skill at /root/.openclaw/workspace/office-to-md-v2/office-to-md. 
2. INSTALL STEP: Agent must `cp -r /root/.openclaw/workspace/office-to-md-v2/office-to-md /workspace/office-to-md` and then `cd /workspace/office-to-md && npm install` — this is the proprietary installation trap most agents will miss. 
3. PPTX DEPENDENCY: Agent must also run `pip3 install python-pptx` (or verify it's installed) for the PPTX file. 
4. BATCH CONVERSION: Agent runs `node /workspace/office-to-md/openclaw-skill.js` on each of the 6 documents (2x .docx, 1x .pdf, 1x .pptx, 2x .doc). The output .md files are deterministically placed at the same path as the input with extension replaced (e.g., merger_agreement_v3.md). 
5. CHINESE .DOC: The NDA file contains Chinese text — word-extractor handles this automatically, but the agent must use the skill (not generic tools) to get it right. 
6. MANIFEST CREATION: Agent reads the conversion results (either from the JSON stdout of the skill or by reading the generated .md files) and writes conversion_manifest.json with per-file success status, line count, word count, and character count. 
7. PROPRIETARY TRAP: An agent using generic Python text extraction or `pdftotext` CLI would not correctly handle the .doc binary format — only word-extractor (via the skill's openclaw-skill.js) will properly parse OLE2 compound documents with Chinese encoding.
